Note: Includes deaths in private state facilities. Excludes persons younger than age 18 and federal prisoners.
a/Population adjusted to resemble the sex, race or ethnicity, and age distribution of the state prison population.

b/Mortality rates may differ from those presented elsewhere in this report due to the removal of state prisoners younger than age 18 from both the numerator (deaths) and denominator (state prison population) and the exclusion of deaths for which cause of death was unknown or missing. These changes were made solely to table 5 to make the mortality rates comparable to those in the U.S. resident population.
c/Includes persons who died of illness and were identified as HIV-positive or having AIDS at the time of death.
d/Includes other specified illnesses (such as cerebrovascular disease, influenza, and other nonleading natural causes of death) and unspecified illnesses.

e/Excludes causes of death that are unlikely to occur in a state prison setting, including motor vehicle accidents; homicides due to explosives or firearms not related to law enforcement, motor vehicle assault, or neglect; and firearm discharges not related to law enforcement.
f/Includes homicides committed by other prisoners, incidental to the use of force by staff, and resulting from assaults sustained prior to incarceration.
